definitions.full: H6504. parad I. [ מָּרַד ] verb divide (Late Hebrew id., divide, separate ; so Syriac in derived species and derivatives; Arabic be single, sole , also (Dozy) unfold, unroll ): — Qal Passive participle feminine plural מְּרֻדוֺת Ezek 1:11 divided , i.e. spread, of wings. Niph`al Perfect 3plural נִפְרְדוּ Gen 10:5 , 32 , נִפְרָ֑דוּ 2Sam 1:23 ; Imperfect , יִמָּרֵד Gen 2:10 ; Prov 19:4 , etc.; Imperative masculine singular נָא הִמָּ֫רֶד Gen 13:9 ; Infinitive construct לוֺט הִמָּֽרֶדֿ 13:14 ; Participle נִפְרָד Judg 4:11 ; Prov 18:1 , נִמְּרָדִים Neh 4:13 ; — 1 divide, separate (intransitive), Gen 2:10 (of river, dividing into branches); of one man separating from another, with מֵעַל 13:9 , 11 , מֵעִם 13:14 (all J), from others, מִן Judg 4:11 ; reciprocal Gen 25:23 (J; of sons of Rebekah representing nations, with מִמֵּעַיִךְ in construction praegn. [Ges § 119ff ], i.e. divided (hostile) from birth); absolute Prov 18:1 ; of peoples separating from ( מִן ) parent stock 10:5 , 32 (P). 2 be divided, separated , 2Sam 1:23 ; Neh 4:13 ; of loss of friendship Prov 19:4 . Pi`el Imperfect 3masculine singular יְפָרֵ֑דוּ Hosea 4:14 make a separation , i.e. go apart (in company with [ עִם ] harlots, compare RS Semitic i. 436, 2nd ed. 455 ). Pu`al Participle divided , הָעַמִּים בֵּין וּמְפֹרָד עַםמְ֗֗֗פֻזָּר Est 3:8 Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular הִפְרִיד Gen 30:40 ; Imperfect יַפְרִיד Ruth 1:17 ; Prov 18:18 , 3 masculine plural וַיַּפְרִדוּ 2Kin 2:11 ; Infinitive construct suffix בְּהַפְרִידוֺ Deut 32:8 ; Participle מַפְרִיד Prov 16:28 ; 17:9 ; — 1 divide, separate Gen 30:40 (JE) Deut 32:8 , of separating friends Prov 16:28 ; 17:9 . 2 make a division, separation , between ( בֵּין ), 2Kin 2:11 ; Ruth 1:17 ; of parting disputants (with בֵּין ) Prov 18:18 . Hithpa`el Perfect 3plural וְהִתְמָּֽרְדוּ Psa 22:15 ; Imperfect יִתְמָּֽרְדוּ 92:10 , רָ֑דוּ - Job 4:11 ; 41:9 ; — be divided, separated, from each other ; of scales of crocodile (c. negative) 41:9 , of bones, = be loosened at the joint, Psa 22:15 (figurative of helplessness); = be dispersed Job 4:11 ; Psa 92:10 .
